paragraphs: Isi son of Mahalalel, [Pesachim 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113b.18). Akavya son of Mahalalel, [Avot, beginning of chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Pirkei_Avot.3.1).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim passage lists Isi son of Mahalalel among the names applied to Isi son of Akavya.
Akavya son of Mahalalel opens the third chapter of Avot with a teaching on avoiding transgression.

The biblical son of Kenan and the patronymics of Isi and Akavya are separate uses of the name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2436&lang=en) also lists the two patronymics under Mahalalel.
